heading: Automotive Axles Jumps 15%: Decoding the Q2 FY27 Rally
tldr: Automotive Axles shares surged nearly 15% following the announcement of strong Q2 FY27 financial results.
The company reported a significant 66.7% increase in net profit, reaching ₹60 crore.
Revenue also saw robust growth, climbing 43.5% year-on-year to ₹663 crore.
EBITDA improved by 73.7%, leading to an expanded EBITDA margin of 12.6% for the quarter.
The company also announced the appointment of Raman K as its new Chief Financial Officer.
caption:
Ever wonder what makes a company's stock jump? Automotive Axles saw a big 15% rise after sharing their latest earnings report. They made much more profit and revenue this quarter, showing strong growth. This is a great example of how good financial results can boost a company's value.
